summary: Restart PostgreSQL after changing shared_buffers. work_mem (default 4 MB) sizes sort and hash memory; set it to Total RAM × 0.25 / max_connections, since too high a value can cause OOM with many connections. max_connections caps concurrent connections. Postgres built against OpenSSL 3.2 can lose the User startup parameter unless patched to use BIO_get_app_data.
questions: How do I calculate work_mem for the controller database?
Do I need to restart PostgreSQL after changing shared_buffers?
Can a large work_mem cause out of memory?
PostgreSQL OpenSSL 3.2 user parameter missing at startup

answer_card.title: PostgreSQL memory settings for controller
answer_card.answer_md:
| Parameter | Default | Guideline |
|---|---|---|
| `shared_buffers` | 128 MB | 15 to 25% of RAM, restart required |
| `work_mem` | 4 MB | `Total RAM * 0.25 / max_connections` |
| `maintenance_work_mem` | 64 MB | `Total RAM * 0.05`, above `work_mem` |

Too large a `work_mem` with many connections can cause OOM.
